title.value: Improved DC-Free Run-Length Limited 4B6B Codes for Concatenated Schemes
title.justification: The title accurately reflects the focus of the paper, which is about improving DC-Free Run-Length Limited 4B6B codes.
title.quote: In this letter, we introduce a class of improved DC-free 4B6B codes in terms of error correction capabilities for a serially concatenated architecture.

extractions.description: This paper proposes an improved version of the traditional DC-free 4B6B codes for visible light communication (VLC) systems. These improved codes offer better error correction performance in concatenated architectures compared to existing schemes. The paper discusses the optimization of these codes based on distance properties and demonstrates gains in bit-error rate (BER) and frame-error rate (FER) in simulations over the original 4B6B code and other baseline codes.

sustainable_development_is_central.justification: The central theme of the paper is technical advancements in communication systems, specifically in coding techniques for VLC, and does not directly address Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) related to climate or ecological factors.
sustainable_development_is_central.quote: Visible light communication (VLC) consists of transmitting information through light by using light emitting diodes (LED) as transmitter and photo detector (PD) as receivers. Due to the saturation and interference within the RF bandwidth, VLC becomes a potential alternative for optical wireless communication.

primary_category.justification: The paper's primary focus is on improving data transmission through visible light communication—an area that doesn't fit directly into specified Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development categories.
primary_category.quote: In this letter, we introduce a class of improved DC-free 4B6B codes in terms of error correction capabilities for a serially concatenated architecture.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper does not focus on any sub-category under the established Climate or Ecological Sustainable Development categories, as its primary goal is technological improvement in visible light communication systems.
primary_sub_category.quote: These codebooks can be classified based on distances properties which determine their error correction performances.

new_primary_category.justification: The paper focuses on technological enhancements in optical communication through VLC, which lends itself to a new category reflecting advancements in communication technology.
